data_collected.text: Name and mobile number for your account.
Microphone and camera access, requested only when you start or join a call.
Call metadata: time, duration and participants of each call.

purposes.text: Running calls, showing call history and detecting abuse.
Optional offers and product news, only if you switch this on.

recipients.text: A cloud hosting provider that processes data on MeetLoop's instructions. MeetLoop says it does not sell personal data.

retention.text: Call metadata for 90 days; account details deleted within 30 days after you delete your account. Recordings stay on your device.

choices_and_withdrawal.text: Turn off camera or microphone in phone settings and marketing under Settings > Notifications > Marketing. Turning marketing off does not affect calls.

unknowns: The name and location of the cloud hosting provider.
How the marketing choice is presented on screen (consent screen not supplied).

data_inventory.retention: Deleted within 30 days after account deletion

data_inventory.purpose: Let others hear and see you during calls
data_inventory.retention: Not recorded unless you press Record; recordings stay on your device

permission_purpose_map.scope: Only when starting or joining a call
permission_purpose_map.rationale: A calling app needs the microphone so others can hear you, and access is limited to calls.
alternatives: Turn off in phone settings when not needed

permission_purpose_map.scope: Only when starting or joining a call
permission_purpose_map.rationale: Video calls need the camera, and access is tied to calls.

consent_dimensions.explanation: Each data type is linked to a specific purpose.
Marketing is a separate choice that does not affect calls.
Camera, microphone and marketing can each be controlled separately.
The notice says marketing is off unless switched on, but the consent screen itself was not supplied.
Withdrawal routes for permissions and marketing are described.
The recipient type and retention periods are stated, though the provider is not named.
No bundling found: the text says declining marketing does not affect calls.

findings.title: Marketing is a separate, optional choice
findings.explanation: Marketing messages need separate permission, are off by default according to the notice, and declining them does not affect calls.

quotes.quote: saying no does not affect your ability to make calls

missing_context: The consent screen, to confirm how the choice is shown
findings.recommended_action: You can leave marketing switched off; the notice says calls are unaffected.

findings.title: Microphone and camera tied to calls
findings.explanation: Access is requested only for calls, and calls are not recorded unless you choose to record.

quotes.quote: MeetLoop asks for microphone and camera access only when you start or join a call

findings.recommended_action: No action needed; you can still turn access off in phone settings between calls.

findings.title: Hosting provider not named
findings.explanation: The recipient category is clear (a cloud host acting on instructions), but the provider and where it stores data are not named.

quotes.quote: We use a cloud hosting provider to run our service.

findings.recommended_action: If it matters to you, ask MeetLoop which hosting provider it uses and where data is stored.

targeted_questions.question: Which cloud provider hosts my data, and in which country?
targeted_questions.why_it_matters: Helps you understand where your call metadata is stored.

next_steps.action: Leave marketing switched off unless you want offers.
If your phone supports it, review camera and microphone access for MeetLoop in phone settings.
